key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 62-73% effective govt take (standard upstream); CIT 20%+MET 11.5%+EPT+royalties; EITI KZ 2022
10-40% progressive EPT when IRR > 25%; 25% representative (EITI KZ 2022 / Tax Code 2018)
~65-75% estimated (MET + EPT + CIT + KMG equity dividend)
N/A — Equity JV concession, not PSC. Costs borne by JV partners pro-rata to equity.
N/A — Equity JV: no profit oil mechanism. Production allocated per working interest (50/25/20/5%).
0% royalty — Kazakhstan replaced royalty with Mineral Extraction Tax (MET) system
0.5-18% sliding scale MET (Subsoil Use Code 2018 Ch.12); 11.5% midpoint representative for oil
KazMunayGas (KMG EP) 20% equity + LukArco 5% (indirect state-linked) = 25% combined state-affiliated
EPT (Excess Profit Tax) 10-60% progressive rate on profits above threshold
MET (Mineral Extraction Tax) 5-18% sliding scale on cumulative annual oil production
